version.author: A-intheCode
version.changelog: + v2.50-beta.6: Hotfix & Improvements: Add Audition & Target Track Selector (`🔊 Audition & Target Track:`) + automatic track arming & forced audition in Circle of Fifths Modal + eliminate internal radial AA seam lines in Circle of Fifths sectors (`draw_annular_sector`) + full Key Signature (`KeySignatureService.resolve_effective_key` & `respell_item_notes`) integration in Melodic Pathfinder (Major & Minor keys) + v2.50-beta.5: Hotfix: Fix `AudioPreview.play_note` `userdata` state indexing crash in MIDI Keyboard Step Input & Circle of Fifths click audition + add global `ImGuiGuardService` stack auto-unwinder preventing `Missing EndChild()` / `Missing End()` errors across all UI modals, drawers & panels + add clear visual gap between Clef and Key Signature in Continuous & Page View + immediate cache invalidation after Scale Transposition + v2.50-beta.4: New: Circle of Fifths & Global Harmonic Chord Palette Modal (`🎡 Circle of Fifths` below Step Input in Sidebar with 8 drag-and-drop tiles, click-to-audition, dynamic harmonic tension calculation & Circle re-coloring, and global multi-tab REAPER persistence) + MIDI Keyboard Step Input in Record Modal (writes 1 Grid length per played note/chord with full Auto-Divisi support) + Key Signature & Scale Note Input fixes across Mouse Drawing (`[D]`), Step Input (`[S]`), Vertical Note Dragging, `♮ Natural [0]` override & `🎼 Set Key Signature` in Scale Modal + v2.50-beta.3: Hotfix: Extend Percussion Clef staff mapping (`GM_DRUM_STEP_MAP`) across the full MIDI pitch range C0–C9 (`0..127`) so pitching notes below C2 (`< 35`) or above A5 (`> 81`) always keeps them centered in the Percussion System without ledger-line jumps + v2.50-beta.2: Hotfix: Restore Percussion Clef staff mapping (`GM_DRUM_STEP_MAP` & `GM_STEP_TO_DRUM_PITCH`) exactly as in v2.50-beta while keeping automatic Cross/Percussion noteheads disabled (manual assignment only via right-click menu) + display `Percussion` in track header subtitle + v2.50-beta.1: Hotfix: Do not automatically convert notes in Percussion Clef systems to percussion noteheads (`x`, `circle_x`, `triangle`, `diamond`) — all notes default to standard noteheads (`●`) unless manually changed via the right-click menu (`🥁 Notehead / Percussion Head`) + v2.50-beta: New: Automatic Percussion Clef detection (`percussion_1`) from track names for true unpitched drums & percussion (`Snare`, `Drums`, `Drumset`, `Bass Drum` / `Gran Cassa`, `Kick`, `Toms`, `Taiko`, `Timbales`, `Bongos`, `Congas`, `Djembe`, `Cajon`, `Tambourine`, `Cymbals`, `Hi-Hat`, `Gong`, `Woodblock`, `Claves`, `Castanets`, `Shaker`, `Cowbell`, `Triangle`, `Percussion` / `Schlagzeug`) while strictly excluding pitched percussion (`Timpani` / `Pauken` -> Bass Clef, `Xylophone` / `Marimba` / `Vibraphone` / `Glockenspiel` / `Tubular Bells` / `Steel Drum` -> Treble Clef, `Celesta` -> Grand Staff) + v2.49-beta: Hotfix: Delete all associated Type 15 notation events (`NOTE`, `NOTATOR_NOTEHEAD`, `NOTATOR_STEM`, `NOTATOR_CHORD_ORIG`, `NOTATOR_ARPEGGIO`, `TRILL`) and `ProjExtState` records when deleting notes + auto-purge orphaned Type 15 events on take parse + flush `2.5*s` stem attachment on `slash` and `diamond` noteheads + v2.48-beta: Hotfix: Exact Elaine Gould & SMuFL stem attachment coordinates (`get_notehead_stem_attachment`), glyph centering & flag scaling (`32*s`) for all 9 Percussion & Custom Noteheads (`standard`, `x`, `circle_x`, `diamond`, `triangle`, `triangle_down`, `plus`, `slash`, `square`) so stems connect cleanly to every notehead contour and downward flags never touch the right side of the notehead + v2.47-beta: New: Percussion & Custom Notehead Selector in Right-Click Context Menu (`🥁 Notehead / Percussion Head`) supporting single and multi-note selections across all 9 SMuFL / Elaine Gould notehead shapes (`standard`, `x`, `circle_x`, `diamond`, `triangle`, `triangle_down`, `plus`, `slash`, `square`, plus `auto`) with MIDI Type 15 (`NOTATOR_NOTEHEAD` / `NOTE head`), `ProjExtState`, Clipboard Copy/Paste & MusicXML `<notehead>` persistence + v2.46-beta: Hotfix: Fix Step Input crash (`AudioPreview` require in `KeyboardHandler`), protect `KeyboardHandler` with `pcall` so `ImGui_End` is never skipped, and fix 5 undeclared global variable references (`_cached_banks`, `is_hov`, `eff_bank`, `all_have_target`, `SlurService`) caught by the new strict `_G` metatable guard in the unit test suite + v2.45-beta: Comprehensive Automated Unit Test & Fuzzing Suite across all 78 Lua modules (604 exported functions, 149 test cases) + defensive nil/type safety across all 15 data classes, Engraver beam/tuplet coordinate fallbacks, SystemEngraver vertical layout fallbacks, ClipboardService argument-order resilience, and MIDI Editor track color safety + v2.44-beta: Complete Elaine Gould ("Behind Bars") & Gardner Read Engraving Compliance: 32nd/64th beam & flag stem lengthening with inner-beam clearance, paired fractional beam stub direction, strict 2-side chord 2nd alternation, dotted chord 2nd collision resolution, staff-line-avoiding articulation placement, slur stem/articulation clearance & chord user-tie outward splitting, tuplet bracket staff/stem/articulation clearance, glissando/portamento dot & accidental gaps, and curved S-bezier Piano/Harp accolade brace (`{`) + v2.43-beta: New: Elaine Gould ("Behind Bars") Optical Spacing & Engraving Engine: Non-linear proportional intra-measure spacing (Δt^0.70), dynamic collision-free measure expansion, intra-bar accidental memory & natural (♮) cancellation, multi-column chord accidental stacking, line-avoiding augmentation dots, middle-line ledger stem extension, and tapered crescent ties & slurs + v2.42-beta: Hotfix: Break beam groups across intervening rests so beams and 16th stubs never collide with rest glyphs + preserve nominal notation durations on Melodic Pathfinder staccato notes + v2.41-beta: Hotfix: Fix Melodic Pathfinder freeze on Reversed + Counter-Melody patterns, auto-jump Edit Cursor to start of selected note pattern & preserve pattern anchor across insertions + v2.40-beta: Hotfix: Auto-Divisi live Note-On voice handover & legato preemption when moving a finger while holding a chord + v2.39-beta: Hotfix: Prevent Auto-Divisi Input JSFX Router from popping up floating FX windows on startup or when arming tracks + v2.38-beta: Hotfix: Block all keyboard shortcuts while renaming Annotation Layers + fix multiline string syntax in Auto-Divisi JSFX router + v2.37-beta: Improvement: Live Audible Auto-Divisi Input FX Router (1 played note = 1 instrument heard in both Smart Register & Top-Down modes, C2 -> Double Bass) + Recording Modal footer gap + v2.36-beta: New: Auto-Divisi Recording Mode (Smart Register & Voice Split across armed tracks with Tick-based chord & legato transition tolerance) + responsive Recording Modal layout + v2.35-beta: New: Replace Tracks modal button with wider View-style Tracks dropdown featuring Auto-Detect Tracks, Check/Uncheck All buttons & crash-safe project-scoped persistence + v2.34-beta: Improvement: Match tile aspect ratio to portrait bar-band geometry (280x420 to 840x1260 px) + Analytical Capsule SDF & 1.25px Smoothstep AA + Quadratic Bezier curve smoothing + v2.33-beta: Hotfix: Eliminate dark bilinear alpha-bleed fringe (Saum / Premultiply effect) via 3.5px transparent color-bleed guard collar around strokes + v2.32-beta: Hotfix: Aspect-correct annotation brush stamps per bar width so vertical and horizontal strokes have identical screen thickness + v2.31-beta: Fix IDAT CRC error & missing-file crash on stroke; add 4-step per-instrument tile resolution selector (1x/1.5x/2x/3x) & 0-latency vector pen preview + v2.30-beta: Improvement: Upgrade per-bar annotation tile resolution to 640x440 px (4.4x pixels) with crisp 0.35px brush edge & row-cached PNG encoding + v2.29-beta: Hotfix: Define AnnotationService.MAX_TRACK_SPACING constant in ScoreCanvas & AnnotationService + v2.28-beta: New: Per-Track Annotation Layer System (12 color presets, freehand Pen & Eraser, lazy 320x200 per-bar PNG tiles & auto-cleanup) + v2.27-beta: Hotfix: Persist manual stem flips (X) via NOTATOR_STEM / NOTE stem tags & ProjExtState, and align 3rd-space stems in low-weighted measures + v2.26-beta: Hotfix: Fix chord/dyad beam grouping, middle-line stem direction & move Tracks button right of All Notes dropdown + v2.25-beta: Hotfix: Fix stuck last note / MIDI overload in Pattern Browser & Melodic Pathfinder preview + v2.24-beta: Hotfix: Synchronize Pre-roll (41818/41819) & Metronome Count-in (projmetroen) with live REAPER dialog refresh + v2.23-beta: Hotfix: Pin Metronome Settings dialog TopMost above Notator & disable I_RECMON when disarming tracks + v2.22-beta: Hotfix: Fix Metronome Settings button (Action 40363) and Pre-roll on Record (Action 41819) in Recording modal + v2.21-beta: Hotfix: Fix auto-slur creation (SlurService.save_slurs) when inserting pathfinder melody + v2.20-beta: Hotfix: Align 4-bar Reference Track window & preserve full bar span in Retrograde + v2.19-beta: Melodic Pathfinder: Clef Register Intelligence, Audition Wakeup & Film Composer Styles 1-4 + v2.18-beta: New: Melodic Pathfinder & Counter-Melody Generator (Corpus-trained Viterbi inpainting, Inversion & Reference Track Harmony) + v2.17: New: 300 Percussion & Low Strings patterns (1,500 total) + Pattern Browser UI refinements + v2.16: Hotfix: Fix severe UI lag when docked in REAPER Docker + v2.15: New: Divisi (split voices to duplicated tracks) + v2.14: Hotfix: Fix AudioPreview require in MidiService + v2.13: Hotfix: Pattern Browser instrument selection & track preview routing + v2.12: Hotfix: Pattern Browser full-length playback + v2.11: Hotfix: Multi-note selection preserved on right-click (Filter Selection & context menu) + v2.10: Staccato dots on all selected notes, pre-staccato articulation auto-chase, slur legato playback & note audition accuracy + v2.0.7: Clean note audition (no REC badge), static canvas focus on click, MusicXML performance optimization, 4K HiDPI maximize & 60-144 FPS native timer + v2.0.4: Reaticulate FX Slot 1
